description: Design a QR code for any content type (link, Wi-Fi, contact, email, SMS, WhatsApp, payments, social profiles and more) with the style you choose: colors and gradients, dot, eye and eye center shapes, a built-in call-to-action frame with its text or a custom frame spec, a border, a logo icon or your own uploaded logo (logo_file_id, with an API key), margin and error correction. Can start from a built-in preset or a community item. Validates the content like the QRdx editor, checks the scan score with the editor's scan check and repairs the style until it is Great (at most 3 repairs, then a classic black-on-white code). Returns the score, what was changed and why, the style JSON (qrdxStyle, ready for save_template and generate_qr_code), a playground_url that opens the design in the QRdx editor, a PNG and the SVG. Call list_options first for the accepted values.

community_item.description: Start from a community theme or frame by id, such as frame:wifi-card (search_community finds them); style options you set win over it

content.description: What the code opens: a type and its fields (list_options lists the fields of every type)

address.description: Contact street address, or a crypto wallet address

encryption.description: Wi-Fi security: WPA (WPA/WPA2/WPA3), WEP or nopass (open)

message.description: Prefilled message (sms, whatsapp) or payment message (bitcoin)

type.description: What the code opens. Fields per type are in the description.

logo_file_id.description: Your own logo: an image you uploaded to QRdx (PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB), by file id. Needs the workspace's API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer qrdx_…).

preset.description: Start from a built-in QRdx theme by id (list_options lists them); style options you set win over it

size.description: Width of the code in pixels (128-1024); frames add to it

style.description: How the code looks. Leave options out for defaults (or the preset's or community item's): eyes and eye centers follow the dot color, square shapes, margin 4, level Q, no frame.

autoLevel.description: Raise error correction to H when the logo covers more than 7% of the code (always on for API renders with a logo)

cornerEyeDotPattern.description: Shape of the corner eye centers

cornerEyePattern.description: Shape of the corner eye frames

dotColor.description: Color of the corner eye centers, #RRGGBB

eyeColor.description: Color of the three corner eye frames, #RRGGBB

eyeColors.description: Per-eye colors: { topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft }, each { outer, inner } as #RRGGBB

secondaryText.description: Second label: bottom band of banner-top-bottom, lower arc of circle, menu-card footer

style.description: Call-to-action frame around the code; none for no frame

text.description: Frame label, at most 24 characters (default "Scan me")

secondaryText.description: Second label: bottom band of banner-top-bottom, lower arc of circle, menu-card footer

spec.description: A frame spec (qrdx.frame v1), for example the style.frame.spec of a community frame from get_community_item

text.description: Frame label, at most 24 characters (default "Scan me")

frame.description: A built-in frame ({ "style": "banner-bottom", "text": "Scan me" }) or a custom one ({ "style": "custom", "spec": … })

gradients.description: Optional gradients; leave a part out for its solid color. Each gradient's colors must contrast with the background like the solid ones

background.description: A two-color gradient that replaces the solid color

angle.description: Linear gradients only: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom

body.description: A two-color gradient that replaces the solid color

angle.description: Linear gradients only: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom

eyeCentres.description: A two-color gradient that replaces the solid color

angle.description: Linear gradients only: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom

eyes.description: A two-color gradient that replaces the solid color

angle.description: Linear gradients only: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom

level.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30% (use H with a logo)

logo.description: A quick logo icon in the center (wifi, location, phone, email, link, file, calendar, whatsapp, instagram), or none. For your own image use logo_file_id.

logoOptions.description: The logo's size, clear space, position, crop and plate

padding.description: Clear space around the logo, 0 to 2 modules

plate.description: A solid plate behind the logo, in its shape

size.description: Share of the code's width, 0.1 to 0.3 (the engine shrinks it when the code can't spare the modules)

margin.description: Quiet zone around the code, in modules (4 is ideal)

shape.description: square (default), or circle: the code in a disc of decorative dots

name: design_qr
title: Design a QR code
